invariants.rationale: The method returns a new instance via 'new', so the returned value ('result') cannot be null.
The method always returns an instance of JavaHoodieBackedTableMetadataWriter.
The StorageConfiguration is directly passed to the constructor and thus is required.
HoodieWriteConfig is required and passed to the constructed object.
HoodieEngineContext is used in the construction and should not be null.
